content.text: Cruisin’ Long Beach since 2006Personalized care for your pets! With our team of compassionate pet care experts, you can trust every service is designed with your furry family member’s comfort and well-being in mind. See how we’re redefining pet care in Long Beach!Compassionate pet care since 2006Serving the Long Beach, Signal Hill and Bixby Knolls communities, we’ve built a reputation rooted in trust and compassion. From nostalgic beginnings with a red wagon (hence our name) to today’s growing team of pet experts, we’re proud to offer personalized, reliable services that make every walk, visit and snuggle feel like home for your fur friends — and peace of mind for you. ​ We’re more than just a pet care company — we’re your pet’s second family.LGBTQ+ friendlyFemale-ownedPersonalized careTeam of pet expertsStress-free bookingLocal to Long BeachPawsome services tailored for every purr, wag, and playtime Pawsome services tailored for every purr, wag, and playtime ServicesFrom dog walks to cat sitting (and all the critters in between), we’re bringing back that genuine, neighborly care that’s often lost in today’s busy world. When you choose Pet Waggin’, your furry friends will be all smiles.Peace of mind for pet parents. Peace of mind for pet parents. What to ExpectWe know how important it is to feel confident in your pet’s care when you can’t be there. That’s why we go above and beyond to ensure your pets are safe, happy and loved. At Pet Waggin’, we treat every furry family member like they’re our own — because let’s face it, they deserve nothing less!Real-time updatesGet timely updates and photos so you can stay connected and see your pet’s happiness in real time, no matter where you are.Safety firstWe prioritize your pet’s safety and well-being with every service. You can relax knowing they’re in loving hands!Trusted expertsOur team of experienced, compassionate pet care pros are trained to handle animals of all personalities and needs.Stress-free ExperienceWhether it’s your first booking or 100th, our team focuses on keeping your furry family members happy and stress-free.Our Booking ProcessBooking your pet’s care is easier than calling up the neighborhood sitter back in the day — just a few clicks, and your furry BFF is all set.Meet the TeamMeet the heart and soul behind Pet Waggin’— a team of pet-loving pros who treat your furry family like their own, with care as genuine as it gets.Happy Paw-rentsDon't just take our word for it...Pet Waggin has been absolute life saver for us. We are the owners of two big pups, Gus our Bernedoodle and Zoe our Chocolate Labrador who are in need of constant attention and exercise. We have Pet Waggin walk our dogs twice a week and take them to the dog park on the other two days of the week. Mary Ellen and her team feel like family. They love and care for Gus & Zoe just like it was one of their own.We get adorable photos during their visits. They are friendly with our neighbors who also speak highly of Mary Ellen and the team and are always mentioning to us how impressed they are with Pet Waggin.We recently worked with their dog trainer Noah who came to the house to train with Gus & Zoe. In just 6 short lessons they have had a complete transformation. They now stay by our side when we walk them and wait patiently on their beds when guests arrive at our home. Two issues we have been dealing with for years till Noah arrived! Noah was also incredibly patient with my husband and I, where he gave us detailed & written feedback, tips & tricks on how to keep up with the training.Mary Ellen and Noah when above and beyond and even spent time with the dog walkers to teach them so they could continue practicing with while on their weekly walks.I highly recommend Pet Waggin. If Gus & Zoe could talk I know they would too!JoanneReady to give your pets the care they deserve?Ah, those SoCal days — sunshine, an ocean breeze and not a worry in the world. That’s the feeling we bring to your pet’s care. Whether cat sitting in your home or a decompression walk along the coast with your pooch, we’ve got your furry friend covered with love, trust and good vibes only. Book your pet’s next adventure today and let us handle the rest!
